# launch: allthings

## before posting

- [ ] allthings.dev serves the new site and every allthingsweb.dev address redirects to it, as every draft says (infra/docs/r2-migration.md, the full cutover). Post nothing before.
- [ ] Every published evening has its short link, as the drafts say: bun run slugs --dry-run (in core/) gives none, or run it without --dry-run first.
- [ ] bunx allthings shows what's next on a machine that never ran it, as the drafts say.
- [ ] Post the X thread from @allthingsdev, each post a reply to the one before.
- [ ] Display names say allthings before the posts do: X, Bluesky, the LinkedIn page, the Discord server and the Luma calendar.
- [ ] Send each Meetup announcement from its own group, to all its members.

## x: thread 1/7 (241 / 280)

All Things Web is now allthings.

The same evenings for people who build software, in the neighborhoods of San Francisco, under one name: allthings/_. An open door and a high bar.

The site is allthings.dev. allthingsweb.dev redirects there.

## x: thread 2/7 (251 / 280)

Each evening fills the slot after the slash, and that's its short link: allthings/effect lives at allthings.dev/effect.

A link, once given, is that evening's for good, so nothing printed, posted or put in a QR code ever comes to mean another evening.

## x: thread 3/7 (159 / 280)

Everyone who has been on stage has a page now, at allthings.dev/people: their talks and parts at our evenings, latest first, and the talks they gave elsewhere.

## x: thread 4/7 (147 / 280)

Some evenings aren't ours. When someone else runs one we think is good, we share it: it's listed beside ours, marked shared, with who organizes it.

## x: thread 5/7 (209 / 280)

Hackathons start from at/hack, a template: fork it, build, hand in a public repo. Projects are judged on whether they work before how they look: judges run each one and its tests.

github.com/allthings-sf/hack

## x: thread 6/7 (216 / 280)

allthings is in your terminal now: bunx allthings shows what's next, and --json gives scripts the same answer.

It reads the public MCP server your agents can add, https://allthings.dev/mcp

npmjs.com/package/allthings

## x: thread 7/7 (125 / 280)

https://allthings.dev/2026-11-05-upcoming

## bluesky (291 / 300)

All Things Web is now allthings, at allthings.dev. allthingsweb.dev redirects there.

New: a short link for every evening, a page for everyone who's been on stage, evenings we share, and at/hack.

Next: allthings/upcoming meetup, Thu Nov 5, 6:00 PM. https://allthings.dev/2026-11-05-upcoming

## linkedin (1295 / 3000)

All Things Web is now allthings.

The evenings stay what they were: for people who build software, in the neighborhoods of San Francisco, about who's on stage and what they built. An open door and a high bar. What changes is the name, allthings/_, where each evening fills the slot after the slash: allthings/effect, allthings/expo.

The site is now allthings.dev, and allthingsweb.dev redirects there. With it:

- Every evening has a short link, allthings.dev/<topic>. A link, once given, is that evening's for good.
- Everyone who has been on stage has a page, at allthings.dev/people: their talks and parts at our evenings, and the talks they gave elsewhere.
- Evenings other people run that we think are good are listed beside ours, marked shared, with who organizes them.
- Hackathons start from at/hack, a template: fork it, build, hand in a public repo. Projects are judged on whether they work before how they look. github.com/allthings-sf/hack
- allthings is in your terminal: bunx allthings shows what's next (npmjs.com/package/allthings). It reads the public MCP server your agents can add, https://allthings.dev/mcp

Next: allthings/upcoming meetup, Thu Nov 5, 6:00 PM. https://allthings.dev/2026-11-05-upcoming

Talk between evenings → discord.gg/B3Sm4b5mfD
On X: x.com/allthingsdev

## discord (932 / 2000)

**All Things Web is now allthings.**

Same evenings, same server. An open door and a high bar. The name is allthings/\_, and each evening fills the slot after the slash: allthings/effect, allthings/expo.

**What changed**
- The site is **allthings.dev**; allthingsweb.dev redirects there.
- Every evening has a short link, allthings.dev/\<topic\>. Once given, it's that evening's for good.
- Everyone who has been on stage has a page: allthings.dev/people.
- Evenings other people run that we think are good are listed beside ours, marked shared.
- Hackathons start from **at/hack**, a template: fork it, build, hand in a public repo. <https://github.com/allthings-sf/hack>
- allthings is in your terminal: `bunx allthings`. It reads the public MCP server your agents can add, `https://allthings.dev/mcp`.

**Next: allthings/upcoming meetup, Thu Nov 5, 6:00 PM.** <https://allthings.dev/2026-11-05-upcoming>

On X: **@allthingsdev**

## luma: newsletter (1258 / 5000)

subject: These evenings are now allthings

All Things Web is now allthings: the same evenings for people who build software, in the neighborhoods of San Francisco, under one name, allthings/\_. Each evening fills the slot after the slash: allthings/effect, allthings/expo. An open door and a high bar.

Nothing changes here: you keep following this calendar, and every evening's seats are still taken here.

**What changed**

- The site is **[allthings.dev](https://allthings.dev)**, and allthingsweb.dev redirects there.
- Every evening has a short link, allthings.dev/\<topic\>. Once given, it's that evening's for good.
- Everyone who has been on stage has a page: allthings.dev/people.
- Evenings other people run that we think are good are listed beside ours, marked shared.
- Hackathons start from **at/hack**, a template: fork it, build, hand in a public repo. <https://github.com/allthings-sf/hack>
- allthings is in your terminal: `bunx allthings`. It reads the public MCP server your agents can add, `https://allthings.dev/mcp`.

**Next: allthings/upcoming meetup, Thu Nov 5, 6:00 PM.** [allthings.dev/2026-11-05-upcoming](https://allthings.dev/2026-11-05-upcoming)

Talk between evenings → **[discord](https://discord.gg/B3Sm4b5mfD)**. On X: **[@allthingsdev](https://x.com/allthingsdev)**.

## meetup: allthings · React & Web · San Francisco (841 / 5000)

group: https://www.meetup.com/reactjs-san-francisco/

subject: allthings/_: these evenings are now allthings

The evenings this group lists were part of All Things Web. They're now allthings: one name, allthings/_, and each evening fills the slot after the slash. An open door and a high bar.

Nothing changes for you here. This group continues under allthings, you stay a member, and each evening is still listed here. Seats are on Luma (luma.com/allthings); the list on Meetup is a waitlist.

What's new on allthings.dev (allthingsweb.dev redirects there): a short link for every evening, allthings.dev/<topic>; a page for everyone who has been on stage; evenings others run that we think are good, marked shared; at/hack, the template hackathons start from; and allthings in your terminal: bunx allthings.

Next: allthings/upcoming meetup, Thu Nov 5, 6:00 PM. https://allthings.dev/2026-11-05-upcoming

Talk between evenings → discord.gg/B3Sm4b5mfD

## about: history (331 characters)

With the name, the site moved from allthingsweb.dev to allthings.dev, and the old addresses redirect. Each evening has its short link, allthings.dev/<topic>, and keeps it. Everyone who has been on stage has a page. Evenings others run that we think are good are listed beside ours, marked shared. And hackathons start from at/hack.
